title: Independent local views
summary: Allocates independent camera/surface lifetimes and the existing split/dynamic pane layouts.

blocks.text: This module allocates independent local viewport lifetimes, camera instances, and rendering surfaces for up to four local players. It computes split and dynamic pane rectangles across side-by-side, stacked, and automatic layouts, maintaining independent zoom, orientation, and focus bindings across viewports without advancing simulation state.

items: Provides view.local@1.0.0 through the LOCAL_VIEWS key: creates LocalViews multi-pane managers and calculates pane layout partitions.
Requires view.camera@^1.0.0 through the VIEW_CAMERAS key: creates independent LocalViewCamera instances for each bound viewport.
Fills the view.local slot in platform profiles.
Initialization binds VIEW_CAMERAS, contributes this guide, and registers the LOCAL_VIEWS provider.
create(options) validates 1 to 4 distinct seat and viewport bindings, instantiates independent cameras and surfaces, and returns a LocalViews controller.
reflow(width, height, separatedGuests) recalculates pane rectangles, toggles pane visibility, and notifies each surface of its resized bounds.
render(elapsed, transform) steps each visible camera frame and renders projected scenes across active surfaces.
dispose cleanly releases all child surface adapters and camera instances.

blocks.text: This module can be replaced by any provider supplying view.local@1.0.0 in the view.local slot. Removing it disables local multi-view partitioning and splitscreen pane allocations.

Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze: pane layout algorithms and viewport surface binding interfaces may evolve before final API freeze.
examples/modules/local-views demonstrates calculating splitscreen pane rectangles and allocating local viewport controllers. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/local-views/module.json /tmp/example-local-views.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/example-local-views.spacemod
